items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Gerry Wiggins and Bill Douglass in a place called the Turban Room on Central Avenue.

ctx.x: And I think that the first place I ever heard Jimmy Jones play was at Eddie Beal's apartment.
You mentioned Gerry Wiggins, and now I'd like to retrogress a bit. After I came back from Honolulu, I worked with Gerry Wiggins and Bill Douglass in a place called the Turban Room on Central Avenue.
That was downstairs in the Dunbar Hotel, was it not?

items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Bill Douglas I think was on drums in that band

ctx.x: Who else was in that band?

Teddy Edwards, Warren Bracken on piano, Bill Douglas I think was on drums in that band, and I had a trumpet player, Eddie...I can't think of his name at the moment either... Anyhow, I think there was about a six-piece band with two basses, which may have been ridiculous, but I liked it.
I wish I could have heard it.
